name: simem
description: Super Intelligence Memory for coding agents: local project memory shared across every agent and account, plus tools that keep context small. The setup skill installs the simem CLI.

interface.longDescription: simem (Super Intelligence Memory) keeps what your coding agents learn about a project on your machine and shares it with every agent and account you use: Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor. It cuts tokens by keeping noisy command output, whole-file reads, and repeated context out of the conversation, and it builds memory with local rules instead of model calls. Everything stays local; the plugin adds skills, and the simem CLI provides the memory tools.
defaultPrompt: Set up simem memory for this machine
What did we decide about this project before?
